newsitem.title: CHILE: Weekly Southern Latam Metals/Mining Highlights.
newsitem.headline: Weekly Southern Latam Metals/Mining Highlights.

text.p: Top stories on metals and mining from Chile, Peru, Brazil, Bolivia and Argentina in the week ending June 27:
SANTIAGO, June 26 - The board of Chile's state copper firm Codelco approved a $98 million investment in a new sulphuric acid plant at its Salvador division, said a spokeswoman.
SANTIAGO, June 25 - Canadian firm Barrick Gold's Tambo gold mine in Chile is closed due to heavy snow, and its El Indio pit is working at a "minimum level," a spokesman said.
SANTIAGO, June 25 - Chile's Refugio gold mine remained closed for the twelfth day as snow ploughs continued working to clear snow from roads to the pit, a firm official said.

SANTIAGO, June 25 - Heavy weekend snowfall at Chilean state owned copper company Codelco's El Teniente mine has damaged equipment and the mine will need some two weeks to reach full production, said a division spokesman.
BUENOS AIRES, June 26 - Argentina's YMAD will try for a second time to tender a large exploration site next to the country's biggest copper project, the firm said.
LIMA, June 25 - Private pension funds bought the largest share, 30 percent, of a $50 million local bond placement by Southern Peru Ltd, market sources said.
LIMA, June 24 - Peru's iron output rose 11 percent to 253,527 tonnes in May compared with the same month last year, according to preliminary Energy and Mines Ministry figures.
LIMA, June 24 - Peru's lead output rose 0.35 percent to 20,973 tonnes in May compared with the same month last year, according to preliminary Energy and Mines Ministry figures.
LIMA, June 24 - Peru's mined zinc output rose 20 percent to 72,795 tonnes in May compared with the same month 1996, according to preliminary Energy and Mines Ministry figures.
LIMA, June 24 - Peru's copper output rose 1.85 percent to 41,086 tonnes in May compared with the same month last year, according to preliminary Energy and Mines Ministry figures.
LIMA, June 24 - Peru's gold output fell 5.26 percent to 5.090 tonnes in May compared with the same month last year, according to preliminary Energy and Mines Ministry figures.

SANTIAGO, June 23 - Chilean copper exports fell slightly in May to $570.5 million from $585.6 million in the same month last year as the result of lower international copper prices, said the Central Bank in its fortnightly report.

SANTIAGO, June 20 - Chilean steel-maker Compania de Aceros del Pacifico (CAP) is studying the development of several small copper deposits in central and northern Chile, said finance manager Jaime Charles.
